FAQ.title: Questions Before Starting the Project
FAQ.subtitle: Short answers about consultation, pricing, development, ownership, and support.
FAQ.q1: Do I need to have a feature list ready?
FAQ.a1: No. You just need to explain your workflow, problems, users, and business goals. Crediblemark will help compile and prioritize the features.
FAQ.q2: Is the entire project handled directly by the founder?
FAQ.a2: Yes. Consultation, analysis, design, and main development are handled directly by the founder of Crediblemark.
FAQ.a3: Crediblemark currently operates as an independent consulting and development service. Specialist partners can be involved for specific needs after consulting with the client.
FAQ.q4: How much does it cost to build a website or app?
FAQ.a4: Pricing is determined based on scope, complexity, integrations, timeline, and support needed. Initial estimates are provided after consultation.
FAQ.q5: How long does the development process take?
FAQ.a5: Duration depends on the project scope. Schedule and development phases will be detailed in the proposal before starting.
FAQ.q6: Who owns the source code and database?
FAQ.a6: Source code, database, and system accesses are handed over to the client according to contract terms after payment obligations are fulfilled.
FAQ.a7: Changes will be evaluated for their impact on cost and timeline. Work is performed once the revised scope is approved.
FAQ.a8: Yes. A bug warranty is available per scope, along with maintenance and further development options.
FAQ.ctaTitle: Don't Know What System You Need?
FAQ.ctaDesc: Tell us the process you want to improve. You don't need to understand technical terms or prepare a feature list. Crediblemark will help map the problem and determine the next steps.
FAQ.ctaSocialProof: Consultation and initial analysis are handled directly by the founder.
